searchText: on teku 22.8.1 (just released with TTD) and geth master I'm getting "Merge is configured, but previously seen beacon client is offline. Please ensure it is operational before the transition arrives! eta..." in Geth log repeatedly. Teku seems happy. Is this expected? That's a new one to me. Is this on MainNet? yes hmm, for MainNet I'd expect Teku to be logging the error `Caused by: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Invalid remote response: -32601: Method engine_exchangeTransitionConfigurationV1 is not supported` since the latest geth release doesn't yet have the mainnet merge config enabled. this is with the current geth code I was getting something like that before I updated geth ( i think it was acutally a ttd mismatch error) I got an "execution client is back online" from teku after updating geth to the latest master version Ok, so that means Teku is able to call the engine_exchangeTransitionConfigurationV1 correctly. I'm not sure why Geth is expecting more than that at this stage. Probably have to get input from one of the Geth devs on that. (cc <@360491619402776577> ) It's a new message we introduced that is locked every couple of minutes if we haven't seen a engine call. Might be something borked with the logic Yeah I think we check every 30 seconds Whats the interval in the spec? And where can I find it? Found it, its 120 seconds and specd here: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/main/src/engine/specification.md#authentication that fixed it 🙏

excerpts.author: ajsutton
excerpts.content: That's a new one to me.  Is this on MainNet?

excerpts.author: ajsutton
excerpts.content: hmm, for MainNet I'd expect Teku to be logging the error `Caused by: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Invalid remote response: -32601: Method engine_exchangeTransitionConfigurationV1 is not supported` since the latest geth release doesn't yet have the mainnet merge config enabled.

excerpts.author: tokey1475

excerpts.author: tokey1475
excerpts.content: I got an "execution client is back online" from teku after updating geth to the latest master version

excerpts.author: ajsutton
excerpts.content: Ok, so that means Teku is able to call the engine_exchangeTransitionConfigurationV1 correctly. I'm not sure why Geth is expecting more than that at this stage. Probably have to get input from one of the Geth devs on that. (cc <@360491619402776577> )

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: It's a new message we introduced that is locked every couple of minutes if we haven't seen a engine call. Might be something borked with the logic

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: Yeah I think we check every 30 seconds

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: Whats the interval in the spec? And where can I find it?

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: Found it, its 120 seconds and specd here: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/main/src/engine/specification.md#authentication
